hypotheses.statement: Commit a3c91f4 replaced the single get_stock_bulk call in checkout/pricing.py with a get_stock call per cart item (an N+1 pattern), so request time now grows with cart size; this fits p95 rising from 125.3 ms to 286.4 ms after the deploy.
A new retry policy in checkout/db.yaml is exhausting the connection pool, increasing latency by 300%.

unknowns: Cart-size distribution before and after the deploy (no cart-size data was available)
Latency of individual inventory get_stock calls

actions.description: Restore a single get_stock_bulk call in price_cart and keep the per-line stock display
actions.rationale: Removes the per-item round trips introduced in a3c91f4

actions.description: Before changing code, confirm by plotting checkout latency against cart size for requests after 12:00
actions.rationale: An N+1 cause predicts latency that scales with item count
